exceptions._comment: Pre-existing transitive dependencies inherited before license checking was introduced. Each entry requires a tracking issue before the next major release.

@lobstrco/signer-extension-api.reason: Transitive dep via @creit.tech/stellar-wallets-kit. Used only in browser context as an optional wallet adapter; not linked into distributed server binaries. Tracking: review whether the dependency can be replaced or isolated.

rpc-websockets.reason: Transitive dep via @solana/web3.js. LGPL allows dynamic linking without copyleft obligation; confirm usage is dynamic before distribution.

@creit.tech/xbull-wallet-connect.reason: Transitive dep via @creit.tech/stellar-wallets-kit. No license field; assumed permissive based on public repo. Needs upstream to add an SPDX field.

@hot-wallet/sdk.reason: Transitive dep via @creit.tech/stellar-wallets-kit. No license field on npm; upstream issue filed.

@near-wallet-selector/core.reason: Transitive dep via @hot-wallet/sdk. MIT licensed per GitHub repo but package.json omits the field.

eyes.reason: Transitive dep via jayson (JSON-RPC library). Effectively public domain; no license field on old release.

text-encoding-utf-8.reason: Transitive dep via borsh. Public domain / Unlicense per upstream README.

notes.approved_rationale: Permissive licenses compatible with commercial distribution.
notes.restricted_rationale: Copyleft licenses that impose distribution requirements incompatible with proprietary use.
notes.review_required_rationale: Weak copyleft or file-level copyleft licenses that may be acceptable depending on usage — require legal sign-off before shipping.
notes.exceptions_rationale: Pre-existing transitive dependencies grandfathered in with documented rationale. New exceptions require explicit review and addition here.
